newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-WELLS QUITS SUSSEX FOR KENT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-WELLS QUITS SUSSEX FOR KENT.

text.p: Former Sussex captain Alan Wells joined Kent on a five-year contract on Monday, eight weeks after being sacked as skipper at Hove.

"The captaincy issue initiated all the upheaval and I decided to look around and see what was available," said the 35-year-old Wells, who made his Sussex debut in 1981. "It is time for me now to look forward and not back."
Kent's 37-year-old batsman Neil Taylor has moved in the opposite direction.
